# CavBot Docs

Documentation index for CavBot.

## Start here

- [Get started](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted) - Create an account, add a website, install Analytics v5, and confirm the first signals.
- [Get started Markdown](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted.md) - Plain text version of the get started page for LLMs and readers that prefer Markdown.

## Core setup pages

- Overview - What CavBot is and when to use it.
- How CavBot works - The basic system behind website intelligence.
- Choose an entrypoint - Where to begin based on what you already have.
- Core concepts - The terms used across CavBot Docs.
- Create your account - Set up the identity CavBot uses for your workspace.
- Add your first website - Create the site profile CavBot will monitor.
- Install the snippet - Send browser-side signals to CavBot Analytics v5.
- Launch checklist - Confirm the first setup is working.
- Go deeper - Where to continue after setup.

## Product areas

- Workspace - Dashboard, reports, CavPad, Arcade, Command Center, members, and roles.
- Website signals - Dashboard, errors, routes, SEO, accessibility, and 404 Control Room.
- CavAi - Models, memory, Caven, Image Studio, and workspace context.
- Developers - SDK, events, API keys, webhooks, Summary API, and Analytics v5.
- Developer tools - CavCode, CavBot Cloud, DevTools, HTML Viewer, and Cav commands.
- Security - Privacy, audit trail, CavBot Vault, CavVerify, CavGuard, and data security.
- Integrations - Wix, Webflow, Shopify, WordPress, GitHub, and custom HTML.
- Billing and plans - Plans, trial, checkout, portal, seats, and cancellation.
- CavBot assets - Badge, Head, Body, Arcade, brand resources, and 404 games.

## Developer menu pages

- [CavBot Analytics v5](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted#analytics-v5) - Install one snippet and send browser-side website signals to CavBot.
- [Events](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted#events) - Send important product actions into CavBot with stable event names and safe context.
- [Summary](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted#summary) - Pull the latest site, route, and dashboard results as a compact operating snapshot.
- [CavAi v3](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted#cavai-v3) - Use CavAi to explain CavBot signals and turn context into next steps.
- [Assistant memory](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted#assistant-memory) - Keep durable project context available for CavAi responses.
- [Agent workflows](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted#agent-workflows) - Run repeatable tasks for reviews, reports, and launch checks.
- [404 Arcade](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted#arcade-404) - Add an interactive recovery surface to broken pages.
- [CavBot Badge](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted#cavbot-badge) - Show a compact CavBot trust marker on a website.
- [CavBot Head](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted#cavbot-head) - Add a small CavBot visual presence to product moments.
- [CavBot Body](https://cavbot.io/docs/getstarted#cavbot-body) - Use the full CavBot visual presence for guided support or recovery moments.
